data.title: 爱夏·花廊下的回眸
data.action: 抬手扶住头纱边缘，转头望向镜头
data.description: 花廊下，爱夏身体朝向石径，转头望向镜头，一只手轻扶被微风带起的头纱边缘，另一只手自然垂在腰侧。象牙白蕾丝长袖与象牙白腰带呼应白色发带。镜头取至大腿上部，白花只沿画面两侧形成边框，夕阳透过头纱，脸部保留柔和反光。
data.promptProse: Under the flowering arbor, adult Aisha turns her head back while her shoulders remain angled along the path, one hand catching the lifted veil and the other beside the ivory sash. Her covered ivory gown has lace sleeves and a modest long skirt. The upper-thigh medium view leaves blossoms at the sides and open space by her face. Low golden sun passes through the veil, while pale paving reflects gentle light into her eyes.
